name: Open a member sub account, without being told the route
description: The same goal as member.openSubAccount.json with the route removed. MERIDIAN Core links to the sub account form from nowhere, so a model that is not told where it is has no way to reach it and gets stuck. This request exists to exercise the handoff for real, where a person takes the live session, navigates the frame themselves, and hands it back. A run a person rescues produces no capability, which is the point of keeping the two requests separate.
goal: open a {{inputs.accountType}} sub account for the member whose member ID is {{inputs.memberId}}, with an opening amount of {{inputs.openingAmount}}. Record the suffix the system assigns as the output suffix.

inputs.name: accountType
inputs.description: The kind of sub account to open
